description: Render an animated SVG (from raw SVG code or file path) into a high-quality video (MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV) or animated image (aPNG, GIF) with in-band Base64 media delivery. Use this tool when you need to convert animated SVG graphics into video or image files. First use inspect_svg_animation to detect duration and dimensions if unknown. Specify svgContent for raw XML input or svgFilePath for local files. Pass transparent: true for WebM/GIF/aPNG transparency.

bgColor.description: Background color hex code (e.g. #ffffff). When transparent is true, acts as a keying/matting color for formats requiring color keying (e.g. gif).

duration.description: Desired animation duration in seconds. If omitted, duration is auto-detected.

format.description: Output media format. Defaults to webm if transparent is true, otherwise mp4.

hold.description: Seconds to freeze the last frame at the end of the video.

outDir.description: Output directory to preserve generated file locally. Omit to deliver purely in-band via ephemeral storage.

resolution.description: Resolution preset (original, 1080p, 720p) or formatted dimension string (e.g. 1080x1080, 1080x1920). Default: original.

scale.description: Scale factor (1-4) when using original resolution. Default: 1.

svgFilePath.description: Path to the input .svg file (required if svgContent is not provided).

transparent.description: Render with full alpha-channel transparency (supported for webm, gif, apng, mov).

name: render_svg_to_video
